_note: Site configuration for this machine. Copy to configs/site.json (gitignored) or point CYCLESCOPE_SITE_CONFIG at a copy. Every setting can also be given by an environment variable, which wins over this file; null / {} means: use the default.
_artifact_root: Root for tools/, build/, captures and caches. Absolute, or relative to the repository root. Env: CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT. Default: <repo>/artifacts
_build_dir: Directory holding the built binaries (cyclescope-engine, cyclescope-capture-facts, ...); prepended to PATH by `cyclescope run`. Env: CYCLESCOPE_BUILD_DIR. Default: <repo>/build
_tracer: NVBit tracer .so per SM architecture, e.g. {"sm_90a": "/opt/cyclescope/tracer-sm_90a.so"}. Env: CYCLESCOPE_TRACER (any architecture). Default: <artifact_root>/build/tracer/<sm_arch>/tracer.so
_ncu: Nsight Compute binary used by `cyclescope reference`. Env: CYCLESCOPE_NCU. Default: ncu on PATH, then /usr/local/cuda/bin/ncu
_nvdisasm: nvdisasm used by the tracer. Env: NVDISASM. Default: <artifact_root>/tools/cuda-toolkit-13.2/bin/nvdisasm
